messages:
olivia: quick idea — when primary model is saturated we should automatically route to a compatible variant, but surface a clear signal in the console and telemetry so SRE/customer teams can act. thinking tenant-aware + region-aware rules.

raj: +1. need to keep tenant tier in the decision (enterprise vs free). enterprise should get priority on capacity.

marta: agree. also we need a well-defined policy schema so teams can opt-in per route. sketch: 
```
fallback_policy:
  trigger: capacity_saturated
  priorities:
    - variant: model-v2-8bit
      min_tier: enterprise
    - variant: model-v2-4bit
      min_tier: standard
    - variant: model-v1-quant
      min_tier: free
  safeguards:
    max_latency_increase_ms: 200
    max_quality_regress_pct: 5
```

kevin: cost-wise we must expose expected unit-cost deltas per variant in the UI, otherwise finance will freak. also, what about kv-cache mismatch across variants?

lia: kv-cache is a big one — fallback should invalidate prefix cache for the request or only fallback for stateless requests. need to surface when cache invalidation happened in traces.

olivia: good call. propose: two fallback modes:
- transparent-fallback: keep cache, allowed only when variant is byte-identical KV format
- stateless-fallback: clear prefix cache and mark request as "escaped" in trace

raj: for routing, prefer: same-region compatible variant -> cross-region fallback -> fallback to cheaper variant. tenants with region-locking should never cross-region. we can add a `region_scope` flag.

marta: console UX — add a per-route "Fallbacks" card showing current policy, recent `fallback_rate`, top affected tenants, and a drill-down that shows example requests. also an action to force-disable fallback for a route.

kevin: telemetry metrics we should emit: `fallback_rate`, `avg_latency_delta_ms`, `tenant_fallback_histogram`, `fallback_by_region`, `fallback_rollback_count`. these are needed for alerting and billing.

lia: +1. alerts: warn at 1% fallback for enterprise routes, 5% for standard, 10% for free. auto rollback when quality-drop > configured threshold in 15m window.

marta: on quality detection — link to evals: we should run sampled responses through the eval harness and publish regression alerts. sample size: up to 100/min for routes with >500 reqs/min.

olivia: edge cases: 
- model incompatible tokenizer => cannot fallback
- model variant changes semantics (stop tokens etc) => need per-variant compatibility flags
- region legal constraints => honor tenant-level policy first

raj: API side: add optional `fallback_policy` block in route config. default conservative: only allow cross-region if tenant permits, prefer same-arch variants. sample API snippet: `POST /routes` body with `fallback_policy` object.

marta: UX hooks: telemetry card, warning badges in deploy view, historical chart for `fallback_rate` over 30d, and a sandbox toggle to run fallback in shadow mode (simulate only).

kevin: implementation notes: runtime needs fast check: capacity_saturated boolean + tenant_score. don't do heavy DB lookups on request path; cache policy in memory and refresh via watch.

lia: we should add an audit log entry for every fallback decision with: tenant, route, chosen_variant, reason, latency_before, latency_after. retention 90d for ops.

deploy-bot: CI build passed for `escape-routing/feature` (build 3482) — https://ci.local/build/3482 :white_check_mark:

olivia: next steps / owners: 
- prototyping runtime check + in-memory policy cache — raj
- API + route config schema — marta
- console cards + telemetry dashboards — lia
- cost/chargeback estimate & unit-cost exposure — kevin
- quick compatibility matrix for known models — olivia

raj: will spike runtime perf and KV-cache complexity tomorrow. will post results in this thread.

kevin: I'll put together a PR with telemetry names and sample Grafana panels.

marta: I'll mock the UI card and shadow-mode toggle by EOD Friday.

lia: created an issue for audit log format: INF-2147. linking here.

olivia: thanks everyone. let's keep the fallback conservative by default and make opt-ins clear in console. :rocket:
